//: nodemon watches js,mjs,cjs,json by default — NOT .env. So editing .env
left the running process with the old environment and no sign that
anything was stale: SMTP credentials were added, nothing restarted, and
the API went on printing verification codes to the console while telling
the browser the email had been sent.
Adding env to the extension list means a credential change takes effect
the moment the file is saved.
